scope: Centered 3.5 by 3 mm receiver throats occupy the flank pockets. Flat mouths meet the split and bearing planes with 3 mm shoulders. PISCO and water-regulator passages have one planar inner flare into their curved cavities. All solid pointed caps and axial end stops retain their geometry.
physical_scope: Geometry readings establish fit, tool space and reversible service routes. Release force and repeated bending remain physical checks.

pisco_bearing_crown.scope: PISCO central 6 mm-wide upper bearing crown over its complete 3 mm axial bearing band. The local side windows retain this crown, the original fitted radius and the rear-wall bore.
